name: Underworld Tunneler
description: A compact tunnel boring machine designed for creating passages through Meridian 88's subsurface geology. The Tunneler chews through rock and reinforced concrete at a walking pace, leaving a passage wide enough for personnel and small vehicles. They were built for emergency access to collapsed underground infrastructure. In practice, they've been used to create unauthorized tunnel networks that riddle the ground beneath the city like worm holes. Several have gone missing from Arcturus inventory.
propulsion: Electric drive, continuous track locomotion, rotary cutting head
speed: 500 meters per hour through standard geology
range: Unlimited with external power. 12 hours on internal battery.
autonomy: Human-operated, geological AI assists with route planning
armament: The cutting head. Nothing else is necessary.
common_usage: Emergency tunnel access, infrastructure repair, mining, creating passages that weren't there before.
story_hooks: A Tunneler has been operating deep beneath The Shelf for months — the vibrations are causing structural damage and no one knows who's driving
Someone finds a tunnel network beneath the city that was bored recently but leads to chambers that are ancient
